title: Becoming Close Context
description: Close context for the outer chain span. On success, carries the final being's FQCN; on failure, carries the exception that ended the chain.

final.description: Fully-qualified class name of the terminal being reached when the chain succeeded.

error.description: Fully-qualified class name of the thrown exception when the chain ended in failure.

message.description: Exception message when the chain ended in failure.
